Nesting with & selector and ${className} embedding. Global styles with :-hono-global pseudo-selector. keyframes for @keyframes animations. cx() composes multiple class names (strings or css results). createCssContext() for custom context (id, classNameSlug, onInvalidSlug). Secure Headers: use nonce attribute with Style component. Security: CSS-in-JS raw sink, validate untrusted input against allowlist. CSS helper css template literal and Style component. css``​ template literal for scoped CSS. Returns: generated class name like css-1234567890. Use: const headerClass = css`​background-color: orange;`​; return c.html(<h1 class={headerClass}>). Style component renders accumulated CSS in head. Pseudo-classes: use & nesting selector like &:hover {background: red;}. Extending: embed class names ${baseClass} to extend. Nesting classes: ${className} {} syntax. Global styles: :-hono-global pseudo-selector. Questions: How write CSS? How to return class? How to use Style? How pseudo-classes? Extend styles? Global styles?

Keyframes for CSS animations. keyframes`​` template literal for @keyframes. Returns: animation name. Use: const fadeIn = keyframes`​from {opacity:0;} to {opacity:1;}`​. Apply: css`​animation-name: ${fadeIn};`​. Pattern: animate element classes with animation names. Questions: How animations? How keyframes? How reference animation?

cx function for composing classes. cx() combines multiple class names. Accepts: CSS results or strings. Example: cx(buttonClass, primaryClass) or cx('h1', primaryClass). Returns: single class name string. Pattern: apply multiple styles per element. Questions: How to combine classes? What cx does? Strings or objects?

Secure Headers integration with nonce attribute. Use with Secure Headers middleware for CSP. Pattern: <Style nonce={c.get('secureHeadersNonce')} />. Import: {secureHeaders, NONCE} from 'hono/secure-headers'. Set NONCE in styleSrc CSP. Prevents CSP violations from CSS helpers. Questions: How to use with Secure Headers? What's nonce? Why needed?

createCssContext for custom CSS context. Function: createCssContext({id, classNameSlug?, onInvalidSlug?}). id parameter: custom style element ID like 'my-app'. classNameSlug function: (hash, label) => string customizes class names. hash: default css-1234567890. label: extracted from /* comment */ in CSS. Example: classNameSlug: (hash, label) => label ? `h-${label}` : hash. onInvalidSlug function: handles invalid class names, logs warning by default. Example: onInvalidSlug: (slug) => throw new Error(...). Questions: How to customize? What's classNameSlug? How comments used? Invalid slug handling?

CSS helper security considerations. Raw CSS sink: like html, raw, rawCssString. Don't pass untrusted input directly. Allows CSS injection. Solution: validate against allowlist. Example: ALLOWED_COLORS = ['red','green','blue'], check input before interpolating. Blocks HTML escapes: quotes, backslashes, </. Allows: {}, ; as valid CSS. Questions: Security risks? What injection? How prevent? Input validation? Escaping?
